issues.description:
[bug-hunt] Progress Photos "Compare" view: the per-pane stepper arrows are inverted relative to the numeric "X/N" counter — the right/next (→) arrow moves the counter DOWN and the left/prev (←) arrow is disabled at position "N/N".

Route: /measurements (Progress Photos card → "Compare" button; opens the full-screen CompareView). Requires >=2 progress photos.

WHERE: src/components/measurements/ProgressPhotos.tsx, CompareView stepper (left pane lines 61-68, right pane 82-89).
  - The <ChevronLeft/> (←) button does setLeftIdx(i => Math.min(i+1, len-1)) and is disabled when leftIdx >= len-1.
  - The <ChevronRight/> (→) button does setLeftIdx(i => Math.max(i-1, 0)) and is disabled when leftIdx <= 0.
  - The counter renders {leftIdx+1}/{photos.length}.
Same inversion in the right ("After") pane with setRightIdx.

WHY: photos come newest-first from the backend (ProgressPhoto.query.order_by(taken_at.desc()), backend.py:9980), so index 0 = newest, index N-1 = oldest. Left pane initializes to leftIdx = N-1 (oldest, labeled "Before"), so its counter opens at "N/N". At that position the ← (previous) button is disabled and the → (next) button is enabled; tapping → decrements the index and the counter counts DOWN (N/N → (N-1)/N → 1/N). The arrow direction contradicts the counter progression: → decreases the shown number, ← increases it.

EXPECTED: standard pagination — ← decrements the "X/N" counter (disabled at 1/N), → increments it (disabled at N/N).
ACTUAL: arrows are swapped vs the counter; → makes the counter go down, ← makes it go up, and ← is disabled while the counter reads "N/N".

REPRO: log in, upload >=2 progress photos, open /measurements, tap "Compare", then tap the → arrow under the left (Before) image — the "X/N" counter decreases instead of increasing (and ← is disabled at "N/N").

FIX: swap the icons (ChevronLeft ↔ ChevronRight) OR swap the onClick/disabled handlers so the ← button decrements toward index 0 and → increments toward N-1, keeping the counter and arrow direction consistent. Apply to both panes.

NOT a dup: no existing issue references Progress Photos or the Compare view (checked data/issues.json all statuses). LOW severity (both photos still reachable; default oldest-vs-newest compare is correct).
issues.author: shakeebshaan

fix.description: In the Progress Photos 'Compare' view, the left/right arrows fought the 1/N counter: the left arrow moved the count up (and was greyed out at the last photo) while the right arrow moved it down. Swapped the arrows in both panes so they follow the counter normally — left goes back (disabled on the first photo), right goes forward (disabled on the last).

judge.note: Root cause (inverted onClick/disabled) fixed in both panes; capture shows correct arrow-enabled/counter direction; surgical, reviewer-confirmed, test gate green.

issues.description: [bug-hunt] Cancel-subscription confirmation dialog renders "until —" (bare em-dash) instead of a date or fallback phrase. Route: /settings/subscription (Profile → Subscription → Cancel subscription). WHERE: src/pages/SubscriptionSettings.tsx AlertDialogDescription (lines 416-419): "You'll keep Pro access until {formatDate(info?.next_charge_date ?? null)}. After that, your plan will revert to the free tier." formatDate(null) returns "—" (lines 77-78: if (!iso) return "—"). WHY IT ALWAYS SHOWS: the file's own comment (lines 265-270) states the backend "doesn't expose renewal details yet", so next_charge_date is null for active/trial subscribers in production — the NORMAL case, not an edge. Every subscriber who taps "Cancel subscription" sees: "You'll keep Pro access until —. After that, your plan will revert to the free tier." INCONSISTENCY: the success toast (handleCancel, lines 159-161) and the pending-cancel banner (lines 312-317) BOTH already guard null and fall back to "the end of your current period" / "the end of your current billing period". Only this pre-cancel AlertDialog lacks the guard. EXPECTED: when next_charge_date is null, dialog should read "...keep Pro access until the end of your current billing period." (mirror the toast/banner). ACTUAL: "...keep Pro access until —." REPRO: log in as an active/trial subscriber (next_charge_date not surfaced by BE), open /settings/subscription, tap Cancel subscription, read the confirmation dialog body. NOT a dup: prior subscription sweep (tick #12) reviewed only the handleCancel TOAST (which has the null fallback and was ruled fine); 9c2e = soft-cancel access-timing, b7a4 = restore false-success toast. This is the confirmation-dialog copy — a distinct, unguarded location. FIX: replace formatDate(info?.next_charge_date ?? null) in the dialog with a null-conditional matching the banner: info?.next_charge_date ? formatDate(info.next_charge_date) : "the end of your current billing period".

issues.reviewReason: Root cause is a missing-asset problem, not a fixable frontend bug. AI-named plan exercises (e.g. 'Pec stretch in doorway', 'Overhead Arm Raise') have no image in the exercise catalog, so the card correctly shows the branded placeholder. The backend's only fallback is a loremflickr keyword URL, which the frontend intentionally blocks (BAD_IMAGE_HOSTS in src/lib/api-config.ts) because loremflickr returns wrong matches. I tested un-blocking loremflickr for exercises and captured the result: it returns irrelevant/duplicate stock photos (the SAME street-statue photo on 4 of 5 exercises) - clearly worse than the clean placeholder, so the block is protecting the premium look. Real exercise images need real demo assets populated in the catalog (backend/asset data-ops). Product call - which do you want: (a) invest in real exercise demo images (image worker / curated set), (b) keep the current clean placeholder, or (c) accept loremflickr stock photos despite the mismatches? No frontend-only change produces good images.

fix.description: Root cause: the live-workout set editor (ExerciseWheelPicker) only let you log/update or add sets — there was no way to remove a set logged by mistake. Fix: expanded logged sets now show a 'Remove set' button (two-tap confirm, calm/no-modal) that optimistically drops the set and calls a new backend DELETE /activity/workout/log-set (WorkoutLogSetResource.delete, verifies ownership + not-completed, idempotent), restoring the set if the call fails. Backend deployed to prod; Activity.tsx resyncs activity-overview + strength-summary after removal.

judge.note: Reproduced the gap: a logged set had only Update/Add-Bonus, no remove. Built a Vite dev harness (logged set) and verified: expanded logged set now shows a red 'Remove set' button (screenshot), tapping it -> 'Tap to confirm' two-tap guard (aria 'Confirm remove set 1'), second tap fires DELETE /activity/workout/log-set. Backend delete() method deployed to prod (endpoint now 401 auth-gated, was 405). -10: end-to-end persistence not driven with a live authed session headless; optimistic-remove + restore-on-failure proven via console (405 pre-deploy -> restore).
